title: Banana Smoothie Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 100ml of vanilla frozen yoghurt, or ice cream
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, plus extra for dusting
ldInstructionsRaw: Peel and chop the banana. Add to a blender with the spices and a dash of lemon juice
Add the milk, frozen yoghurt and honey and blend until smooth
Divide into glasses, sprinkle over a pinch of ground nutmeg and serve with a straw
